about_the_game:
Get this DLC to host Aye, Dark Overlord! games. Other players can join using the base game only.

  • 4-6 Players | 30-45 mins

  • Recommended Age: 13+

Enter the chaotic world of Aye, Dark Overlord!, the hilarious party game of wild excuses and shifting blame, perfect for both newcomers and seasoned players, now fully adapted for VR. Play as a trembling goblin minion trying to survive, or take on the role of the fearsome Rigor Mortis himself.

This VR edition includes content from both the original red and green box sets. Step into the Dark Overlord’s court with your friends, where storytelling moves fast, thinking is quick, and improvisation knows no shame.

As a goblin servant, invent absurd excuses, point fingers, and try to deflect blame for your latest failure. Use Action Cards to derail rival stories and keep everyone on their toes. Or play as the Dark Overlord, demanding answers and deciding which tale does not add up.

Key Features:

  • Includes both Green and Red Box editions, playable separately or combined

  • Play as the Dark Overlord, featuring an exclusive Rigor Mortis appearance

  • Build your perfect excuse using the “Hint Cards”

  • Use the “Action Cards” to create unpredictable chaos

  • Includes a themed environment and dedicated soundtrack

  • Available in EFIGS

  • Fully adapted for VR, exclusively on All On Board

  • Quick learning with the rulebook, video tutorial, and wiki glossary

Can you talk your way out of trouble, or will you suffer the Overlord’s wrath?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10, Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel i5-4590 / AMD Ryzen 5 1500X or greater
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1650 or AMD equivalent
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • VR Support: Meta Quest 2, Meta Quest 3
  • Additional Notes: 1x USB port
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10, Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel i7 / AMD Ryzen 7
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia RTX 20 Series* / AMD Radeon RX 6000 Series
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • VR Support: Meta Quest 2, Meta Quest 3
  • Additional Notes: 1x USB-C port
